allowedWork: Per-card experiment controls; ephemeral scene observation; semantic-constrained total reconciliation; one hierarchical generic scene sampler; canonical fraction exemplar; focused visual, browser, accessibility, performance, architecture, project-memory, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: No operation-specific scheduling, durable renderer state, branch/radical/compound/text/code/production rollout, radical repair, Manim/Python/CAS/live-LLM work, clone semantic authority, or unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
goal: Prove one total semantic-constrained rendered-notation scene compositor on the canonical fraction merge, beginning with per-card playback controls and ending at a human visual checkpoint.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and its completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if painted atoms cannot be totally and deterministically enumerated without scattered brittle KaTeX heuristics.
Stop if visual equality must establish semantic lineage or any painted source or target atom remains implicit.
Stop if operation-, fraction-, radical-, branch-, or viewport-specific matching, lifecycle, or scheduling is required.
Stop if DOM nodes, geometry, tracks, keyframes, or backend plans enter durable artifacts, or moving clones own semantic affordances.
Stop if one bounded shared correction cannot eliminate whole-subtree jumps or native handoff typography changes.
Stop if performance, payload, accessibility, semantic, reader, review, production, static-JS, seek, or rewind checks regress.
Stop before branch, radical, compound, text/code, production-family, Manim, CAS, live-LLM, or unrelated rollout.
Stop at slice 20 for explicit human visual approval before generalization.

slices.title: per-card-playback-controls
slices.summary: Added synchronized play, seek, pause, status, and rewind controls to all four equation cards; playback resumes from the selected shared progress and trace drill-down disables/restores every local control.

slices.title: failure-and-coverage-ledger
slices.summary: Recorded four focal-only failure modes and six full-scene acceptance laws so safe focal fallback cannot be mistaken for continuous whole-expression motion.

slices.title: rendered-scene-contracts
slices.summary: Added frozen renderer-session scene, paint-atom, presentation-group, and endpoint contracts with geometry, identity, document, ownership, and serialization guards.

slices.title: paint-bearing-dom-enumeration
slices.summary: Enumerated visible direct-text KaTeX paint leaves with deterministic IDs, local geometry, paint fingerprints, and explicit exclusion of MathML and hidden ink.

slices.title: structural-atom-observation
slices.summary: Extended exact paint observation to generic rules, SVG/path material, delimiters, and accents; the source fraction exposes two stable rule atoms without fraction-specific behavior.

slices.title: semantic-ownership-propagation
slices.summary: Added nested compiler-authored semantic and presentation-group wrappers to both fraction endpoints and projected nearest explicit ownership onto every observed paint atom.

slices.title: scene-settlement-and-invalidation
slices.summary: Complete scene observation now waits for fonts, compares two stable layout frames, builds nested group bounds, and keys results by endpoint, viewport, DPR, and font revision.

slices.title: complete-endpoint-inventories
slices.summary: Observed and exposed complete source and target fraction paint/group inventories at route startup; extracted experiment fixture and geometry helpers to preserve the controller complexity ratchet.

slices.title: total-reconciliation-validator
slices.summary: Added a total scene reconciliation validator requiring each source and target paint atom exactly once across persistent, merge, split, introduction, elimination, or reasoned unsupported dispositions.

slices.title: grouped-constrained-matching
slices.summary: Added deterministic visual-key pairing within shared semantic owners and explicit persist/merge/split relations; all remaining atoms receive generic introduction or elimination.

slices.title: hierarchical-scene-reconciliation
slices.summary: Compiled total reconciliation into group-bounded lifecycle components whose child paint atoms retain endpoint-local residual rectangles, avoiding flat competing motion ownership.

slices.title: generic-scene-tracks
slices.summary: Compiled hierarchical lifecycle components into generic rect/opacity tracks and a pure smoothstep sampler with exact endpoint, finite-value, direct-seek, and reverse laws.

slices.title: rule-and-structural-interpolation
slices.summary: Marked structural rule tracks with generic length sizing and proved exact source/target rules interpolate position and width continuously through the shared scene sampler.

slices.title: generic-merge-and-departure
slices.summary: Added generic convergence-first merge opacity, split/arrival windows, and eight-pixel local introduction/elimination motion so lifecycle changes remain visible without subtree switching.

slices.title: exclusive-full-scene-ownership
slices.summary: Added exclusive source-native, inert full-material-scene, and target-native ownership handoff; every complete scene track receives one deterministic material owner and no semantic or interaction authority.

slices.title: deterministic-scene-sampler
slices.summary: Added a frozen renderer-session playback wrapper with one pure sampler and one exclusive DOM apply path; direct seek, replay, and rewind share identical stateless frames.

slices.title: full-scene-fraction-exemplar
slices.summary: Replaced the denominator-only visible path with total fraction scene playback; native source and target remain exact endpoints while every glyph and fraction rule is material-owned throughout the shared interior clock.

slices.title: semantic-affordance-preservation
slices.summary: Bound source, stage-description, and target semantic ownership to the same scene frame; native target focus and Cloze persist across rewind, while every material owner remains aria-hidden, inert, and paint-only.

slices.title: responsive-performance-complexity-gate
slices.summary: Added a generic 32-paint-track sampler stress gate, removed obsolete denominator-only planner compilation, and passed payload, build, production-boundary, module, controller, responsive, and regression budgets.

slices.title: fraction-decision-checkpoint
slices.summary: Completed the release matrix and durable checkpoint record; the canonical fraction exemplar is reviewable and the run stops at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before any branch, radical, compound, text/code, production, or backend generalization.
